title: Skill as Memory, Not Document: A Database-Native Substrate for Agent Skill Catalogs

live_model.evidence: "exceeding GPT-4 Turbo 128K and Claude 3.7 200K windows entirely" (Results section, context-window size comparison only; no experiment run)

prompt.note: Paper reports the authors' own YantrikDB retrieval-substrate benchmarks; no prompt to GPT-4 Turbo is shown or implied.

claim.metric: none for the live id (used only as a context-window size reference)

data.source: Authors' own 5,000-skill corpus and 70-item adversarial admission set (paper states a public reproducible corpus); unrelated to the GPT-4 Turbo mention

notes: The paper's actual measurements (token counts, retrieval latency, admission rate) are about the authors' own skill-storage substrate, not about running GPT-4 Turbo; the model is cited only for its 128K context-window size as a comparison point.
